candidateQualification: Conditional candidates only. Local names exist and local reads succeeded; Preview/Production credentials remain absent and no activation is authorized by this report.
previewPlan: For observations, verify KMA_MARINE_STATION_API_KEY and KMA_MARINE_OBSERVATION_API_KEY authorization/quota; register secrets in Preview only; deploy Preview; smoke station catalog and an exact selected station; compare source TM to official :00/:30 cadence; inspect units, stale behavior and page isolation.

For warnings, verify KMA_MARINE_WARNING_API_KEY authorization/quota; register it in Preview and only then enable KMA_MARINE_WARNING_ENABLED in Preview; deploy Preview; smoke current/history/zone paths, zero-warning state, lifecycle and per-card isolation.
For each candidate, inspect request counts and concurrent cold loads, ensure no client key or upstream URL exposure, run 200/error/timeout/stale UI checks and confirm /today-sea HTTP 200 throughout.

Only after Preview passes, evaluate a separate Production gate: production-scoped key and quota, official freshness, bounded latency/volume, no key leakage, explicit source labels, error rollback plan and approval. No Production change in this audit.
